title: I Printed the Color-Printer Quota After They Ran Flyers on My Code

parts.text: My color quota dropped forty pages at 9:12 a.m. on flyers I did not design. The release station showed intern Cal's job on my code. The IT card said: YOUR CODE. YOUR PAGES. I was thirty, coordinator, holding a screenshot. Cal said it was a leftover login. Leftover is a word flyers use when a code exists. I printed the screenshot for IT. Quota restored. Cal logs into Cal. The copier finally looks like a quota, not a campaign. The rule looks ordinary now, which is the whole point. If it is written, it can be applied to the person who wrote it.

social.video_title: The intern printed flyers on my color code — Part 1/1
social.description: Quota drop, a leftover login, restored pages. Has a campaign ever been your code?
